# Moonlight Machinery

> Moonlight Machinery is a Gurgaon (Haryana, India) manufacturer and supplier of paper plate making machines, dona (paper bowl) making machines, hydraulic single and double cylinder paper plate machines, lamination machines, and cotton wick machines. Founded in 2011, it has delivered 2,300+ machines to small manufacturers across 19 Indian states, with pan-India dispatch, genuine spare parts, and after-sales support.

Moonlight Machinery sells machines (not finished plates) to entrepreneurs and small manufacturers. Typical search topics this site answers: paper plate making machine price in India, hydraulic single die and double die paper plate machine, fully automatic and semi-automatic paper plate machine, dona making machine, buffet plate machine, lamination machine, and spare parts. Content is written for buyers in India. Prices are quoted on enquiry; contact the team for a current quote.

- [All Machines](https://www.moonlightmachinery.com/home/machines): Full catalog of hydraulic single/double cylinder paper plate making machines, dona making machines, and lamination machines
